resolution_notes: docs_url: KEEP original. https://www.steamgriddb.com/api/v2 is SteamGridDB's official API v2 documentation location. The official SteamGridDB GitHub wrapper links back to that URL as the API reference: https://github.com/SteamGridDB/node-steamgriddb. The v1 page explicitly identifies itself as deprecated: https://www.steamgriddb.com/api/v1. The v2 documentation renderer currently reports a missing OpenAPI file, but this does not make the wrapper repository the canonical docs URL.
